summary: Records the six merge requests merged on 2026-10-25 (!20 to !25, with the merge times read from the API, and that !25 merged before !24) in docs/submission/evidence.md, and adds docs/submission/coverage-measurement.md: 86 percent line and branch coverage over src/ and scripts/, 95 percent on src/afaw_web, measured locally and not on the runner. No link of the hands-off table changed: none of these merges ran a Duo flow. A coverage gate is proposed, not built, because it edits human-only files. Also documents in docs/autohealing.md that the merge is a setting: AFAW_AUTO_MERGE unset is continuous delivery, true with AFAW_MERGE_TOKEN is continuous deployment by merge_guard (code and tests exist, never run on a real merge request). Adds gotcha 0004 (an agent said the merge had no path and had to stay a human click, when merge_guard, ADR 0007 and docs/duo.md already planned it), a rule in CLAUDE.md, and corrects the README rows that listed the merged task 012 as Planned. Records the answers of Duo Chat of 2026-10-25 in docs/autohealing.md: no merge tool is documented for custom agents (gitlab_accept_merge_request exists in Chat and accept_merge_request in the MCP server since 19.4); the REST call merge_guard makes is documented; the trigger events need a human; Draft, the post-merge comment and the branch filter have no documented answer. The agent tool list of 2026-10-25 has no tool that accepts or arms a merge, so the merge stays with merge_guard and its token. Adds docs/submission/rules-and-coverage.md (the Devpost rules and how much of each requirement and prize is covered: 8 of 12 requirements, 8 of 13 loop links ran at least once, 0 of 13 without a person, 9 of 9 stages with a running job), docs/experiments.md (catalog EXP-01 to EXP-09 with data tables, what can and cannot be measured), the README rows that were out of date, a Goal and priorities section in CLAUDE.md, and Phase 4 plus a low-priority security list in PENDING.md.
